title: Scheduled backup
scheduleHelp: 5-field cron expression, e.g. 0 3 * * * runs daily at 03:00; {'@'}daily and {'@'}weekly also work
keepHelp: Keep the latest N backups for each destination
passwordSet: Already set; leave empty to keep it
passwordHelp: When set, backup files are saved as .zip.enc and the same passphrase is required to restore; a lost passphrase cannot be recovered
localDirHelp: Writes to the backups folder in the config directory
targetsEmpty: Optional: sync backups to a mount in "Storage Mounts" (local directory, WebDAV or SMB)
confirmDeleteTarget: Delete this destination? Backups already written are kept
noMounts: No mounts yet. Add one in "Storage Mounts" first
dirPlaceholder: e.g. gately-backups; leave empty for the root
